name: 98332 · Gig Harbor, WA
findings: ZIP 98332 (Gig Harbor) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98332 (Gig Harbor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
